objective: Verificar numericamente R85B en LA ESTELAR antes de sincronizar: 04/09 debe incluir ticket 24667 y totalizar 119840 con 81 cheques y 195 PAX; 05/09 debe totalizar 252998 con 167 cheques y 480 PAX. No escribir datos.

queries.name: estelar_operational_day_04_05
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(date, DATEADD(hour,-9,tr.apertura)) AS fecha_operacion, CAST(SUM(ch.total) AS decimal(18,2)) AS ventas_total, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.folio) AS cheques, SUM(ISNULL(ch.nopersonas,0)) AS pax FROM cheques ch INNER JOIN turnos tr ON tr.idturno=ch.idturno WHERE tr.apertura>='2026-09-04 09:00:00' AND tr.apertura<'2026-09-06 09:00:00' AND ch.cancelado=0 GROUP BY CONVERT(date, DATEADD(hour,-9,tr.apertura)) ORDER BY fecha_operacion

queries.name: ticket_24667_operational_assignment
queries.sql: SELECT ch.folio, ch.numcheque, ch.total, ch.nopersonas, tr.idturno, tr.apertura, CONVERT(date,DATEADD(hour,-9,tr.apertura)) AS fecha_operacion FROM cheques ch INNER JOIN turnos tr ON tr.idturno=ch.idturno WHERE ch.folio=24667
